title: 第2285章 底气大增第2284章 一死一伤
slug: 反派不朽帝族族人竟都是老六
content_zh:
“给我住手！”
禁天厉声怒喝，他将道则之力汇聚于双臂之上，径直朝神主后心拍去。
面对禁天的攻击，神主视若无睹，他依旧在全力轰击宝库禁制。
“砰砰砰！”
巨响声不绝于耳，在神主的一番连续攻击下，笼罩宝库入口的禁制再也支撑不住，守护屏障浮现出大量裂纹。
而禁天的攻击，此时已落在神主身上。
“砰！”
恐怖能量在神主后背炸开，整得他一阵踉跄，覆盖身躯的铠甲瞬间碎裂，后背上更是多出一道狰狞伤口。
暗金色血液从伤口处溢出，虚空中充斥着浓郁血腥味。
禁天这一击效果十分显着，给神主造成了不轻的伤势。
可纵然被禁天所伤，神主依旧头也不回，全程无视对方，自顾自轰击禁制。
“轰隆！”
终于，在神主持续不断攻击下，禁制彻底崩塌，宝库大门没了禁制守护后，直接被他一掌拍成齑粉。
“哈哈哈！”
神主放声大笑。
“成功了，终于成功了。”
伸手抹去嘴角溢出的鲜血，神主回头扫了禁天一眼，冷笑道：“看来本帝才是最后的赢家，终究是让你失望了。”
禁天拳头紧握，他疯狂调动幽冥之气，满含杀意的双眸锁定神主，寒声道：“不要得意得太早，吾族资源可没有那么好拿。”
“是吗，本帝倒要看看有多不好拿。”
此话一出口，神主不给禁天再次说话的机会，他整个人化作一道残影，径直朝入口处冲入，眨眼功夫便没入宝库。

“咻！”
神主冲入宝库后不久，灵玄机姗姗来迟，看着被摧毁的宝库大门，他眉宇间满是焦急之色。
“禁主，这下怎么办？”
灵玄机属实想不出应对之法，只能将希望放在禁天身上，希望他有应对之色。
“呵呵！”
禁天闻言轻笑一声，上一秒还是神色阴沉的他，此时突然咧嘴一笑，眉目间没有丝毫担忧之色，看起来心情似乎还十分不错。
“禁主，你这是？”
禁天的这一反应，让灵玄机脸上疑惑之色更甚，神主这都冲入自家宝库了，他还能如此淡定，属实有些异常。
“放心，一切尽在掌控之中。
“在进入混沌小世界的第一时间，本帝便命人转移资源。”
“刚才你我拖延了那么长时间，宝库内的资源早就安全转移，神主那家伙注定空欢喜一场，什么都拿不到。”
听完禁天解释，灵玄机一脸佩服，眉目间担忧之色消散一空，发自内心恭维：“禁主英明，属下佩服。”
灵玄机本以为这次会损失惨重，没想到峰回路转，禁天竟提前留了一手。
“禁主，既然宝库内资源已安全转移，那我们还是抓紧时间离开吧，若神主折返回来，到时想走就没那么容易了。”
content_en:
"Stop it!"
Jin Tian shouted angrily, he gathered the power of Tao on his arms and slapped the God Lord directly on the back of the heart.
In the face of Forbidden Sky's attack, God Lord turned a blind eye, and he still bombarded the treasure house's restrictions with all his strength.
"Bang bang bang!"
Loud noises were heard endlessly. Under the continuous attacks from the God Lord, the restriction covering the entrance to the treasure house could no longer be sustained, and a large number of cracks appeared in the protective barrier.
At this time, Forbidden Sky's attack had fallen on the Divine Lord.
"Bang!"
Terrifying energy exploded in the back of the God Lord, causing him to stumble. The armor covering his body instantly shattered, and there was a hideous wound on his back.
Dark golden blood overflowed from the wound, and the void was filled with the rich smell of blood.
The effect of Jintian's attack was very significant, causing serious injuries to the Lord of God.
But even though he was injured by the Forbidden Sky, the Divine Lord still didn't look back, ignoring the other party the whole time, and bombarding the Forbidden One on his own.
"Boom!"
Finally, under the continuous attack of the God Lord, the restriction completely collapsed. After the treasure house door was no longer protected by the restriction, it was directly smashed into powder by his palm.
"Hahaha!"
The God Lord laughed loudly.
"It worked, it finally worked."
Reaching out to wipe away the blood that spilled from the corner of his mouth, the Divine Lord turned back and glanced at Ji Tian, sneering: "It seems that I am the final winner, and I will let you down after all."
Jiantian clenched his fists, and he frantically mobilized the energy of the netherworld. He locked eyes full of murderous intent on the God Lord, and said in a cold voice: "Don't be too proud, our resources are not that easy to get."
"Really? I want to see how difficult it is to get it."
As soon as these words were spoken, the Lord of God did not give Jin Tian a chance to speak again. He turned into an afterimage and rushed straight towards the entrance, disappearing into the treasure house in the blink of an eye.
"Phew!"
Not long after the God Lord rushed into the treasure house, the spiritual mystery came belatedly. Looking at the destroyed treasure house door, his brows were full of anxiety.
"Forbidden Lord, what should we do now?"
Ling Xuanji really couldn't think of a way to deal with it, so he could only place his hope on Jin Tian, hoping that he would be able to deal with it.
"Haha!"
Jin Tian chuckled when he heard this. He was still looking gloomy a second ago, but now he suddenly grinned. There was no trace of worry in his brows, and he seemed to be in a very good mood.
"Forbidden Lord, what are you doing?"
Ji Tian's reaction made Ling Xuanji's face even more confused. The God Lord had already rushed into his own treasure house, and it was really unusual for him to be so calm.
“Don’t worry, everything is under control.
“As soon as I entered the small world of chaos, I ordered people to transfer resources. "
"You and I have been delaying it for so long just now. The resources in the treasure house have been safely transferred long ago. The God Lord is destined to be happy in vain and get nothing. "
After listening to Jin Tian's explanation, Ling Xuanji looked impressed, the worry in his brows disappeared, and he complimented from the bottom of his heart: "Jin Lord is wise, and my subordinates admire him. "
Ling Xuanji thought he would suffer heavy losses this time, but he didn't expect a twist of fate, and Forbidden Sky actually saved a hand in advance.
"Forbidden Lord, since the resources in the treasure house have been safely transferred, we should hurry up and leave. If the Lord of God turns back, it will not be so easy to leave. "
